mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing mutual metabolism competition; tamoxifen requires CYP2D6 conversion to active metabolite endoxifen, while haloperidol undergoes CYP2D6/3A4 metabolism, leading to altered efficacy and increased haloperidol levels.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, QT prolongation) and reduced tamoxifen efficacy; consider alternative antipsychotic or dose adjustment with increased therapeutic drug monitoring.
